corrected: verified against Showdown source (abilities.ts rockhead onDamage) — it only intercepts `effect.id === 'recoil'`, and explicitly does NOT block it when the active move is Struggle (`if (this.activeMove.id !== 'struggle') return null;`). Crash damage from Jump Kick/High Jump Kick/Axe Kick uses a different effect id (the move's own id, e.g. 'axekick'), not 'recoil', so it is NOT blocked by Rock Head — contrary to the previous claim that both categories are blocked. Rock Head only prevents true recoil (Double-Edge, Flare Blitz, Take Down, etc.), and even that exception doesn't cover Struggle's own recoil
